### Orthofix to Participate in Upcoming Investor Conferences


July 20, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s21.q4cdn.com/785927921/files/doc_news/Orthofix-to-Participate-in-Upcoming-Investor-Conferences-474c8a410-2026.pdf)


LEWISVILLE, Texas--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


[Orthofix Medical Inc](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Forthofix.com%2F&esheet=54564427&newsitemid=20260720677215&lan=en-US&anchor=Orthofix+Medical+Inc&index=1&md5=4d585f7d4814b14f690f98de593f89e3) . (NASDAQ:OFIX), a leading global medical technology company, today announced that Orthofix will participate in the following investor conferences:


- **Needham Virtual MedTech & Diagnostics 1x1 Conference** - Virtual, August 10, 2026, 1x1 Meetings
- **Canaccord Genuity’s 46th Annual Growth Conference** - Boston, August 12, 2026, Fireside Chat Time: 9:30 am Eastern Time


Interested parties can access the live and archived webcast of the Canaccord Genuity fireside chat in the “Events & Presentations” section of the Orthofix Investor Relations Website at[ir.orthofix.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fir.orthofix.com%2Fevents-and-presentations%2F&esheet=54564427&newsitemid=20260720677215&lan=en-US&anchor=ir.orthofix.com&index=2&md5=71a8837cbafe4a263c9d04f58b9d9b40) .


**Internet Posting of Information**


Orthofix regularly shares important updates in the “Investors” section of its website at[www.orthofix.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Forthofix.com%2F&esheet=54564427&newsitemid=20260720677215&lan=en-US&anchor=www.orthofix.com&index=3&md5=da5ca9fbc7c34974d80ba2c150e9fd5a) . The Company encourages investors and potential investors to consult the Orthofix website regularly for important information about Orthofix.


**About Orthofix**


Orthofix is a global medical technology company dedicated to advancing healing and restoring mobility for patients with complex musculoskeletal conditions. Headquartered in Lewisville, Texas, the Company delivers technology-enabled solutions that support improved clinical outcomes and more efficient care across the continuum. Orthofix offers a focused and differentiated portfolio spanning spinal implants, therapeutic solutions, limb reconstruction systems, biologics and enabling technologies, including the 7D FLASH™ Navigation System. Learn more at[Orthofix.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Forthofix.com%2F&esheet=54564427&newsitemid=20260720677215&lan=en-US&anchor=Orthofix.com&index=4&md5=41ea51cb563c94f7b4adebc3a79220dc) and follow Orthofix on[LinkedIn](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.linkedin.com%2Fcompany%2Forthofix%2Fposts%2F&esheet=54564427&newsitemid=20260720677215&lan=en-US&anchor=LinkedIn&index=5&md5=4f1e239eef8f2bb0ddbf7dcc9ccbd91a) .
